claims.statement: All 726 specified Java constructor traces are present exactly once and decode injectively from complete typed OnePort values.
All 242 Seq traces preserve the input sequence; the independent checker proves this property for every accepted Seq trace.
All 242 Bag traces preserve every operand multiplicity; the independent checker proves this property for every accepted Bag trace.
All 242 Set traces preserve exactly the operand support and have duplicate-free outputs; accepted Set traces preserve any/all evaluation for arbitrary operand denotations.
All 726 occurrence-fiber tables partition the input indices with identity-preserving members, one fiber per output, singleton Bag/Seq fibers, and positional Seq fibers.
The fixed negative controls are rejected by the independent Lean checker and the census checker detects missing, duplicate, or invalid rows.
The AND/OR smart-constructor model and its mapped Java regression tests pass; empty and singleton cases preserve Boolean evaluation without granting a stored unit law.
Two isolated builds produce identical Java class files, proof source and compiled proof objects, trace payloads, and per-claim outcomes from one frozen input root.
